name: smwmusic-crash-nitro-kart-invincibility-all-variations
title: Crash Nitro Kart - Invincibility (All Variations)
description:
A short tribal 3 second loop with bongos and a xylophone melody that changes depending on the mask used.

You can define in the .txt file which variation you want to use:
0 - Aku-Aku
1 - Uka-Uka (0x00B2)
2 - Velo Mask (0x00B5)
